# phase-108 — Separate the package version from the language version

## You must change `src/`

This phase declares `must_touch: [src/]`. The gate fails the phase unless at
least one changed file falls under it. Writing tests, documentation or a report
is not enough — if you finish without touching that area, the phase fails on
exactly that check.


## Evidence — verified finding

```
src/manifest.rs already resolves semver ranges and pins a lockfile, so the package machinery works, but nothing states whether a package version is independent of the Redblue version that resolves it. Left unstated, every future package will encode the language version somewhere - in its version number, in a required-version field, or in a comment - and the first time Redblue makes a backwards-incompatible change, packages will not know which language they need. This is the cheapest possible fix and the most expensive possible time to fix it.
```

**Re-verify this before you change anything.** If the finding no longer
reproduces on `main`, stop and write that to `FINDINGS.md` — a stale phase must
never be "fixed" by inventing a change.

## Goal

Decide and document the relationship: package versions are independent of language versions, and a package declares the range of language versions it supports rather than mirroring them. Make the manifest able to carry and enforce that range, so a package declaring incompatibility is refused at resolution time with a message naming both versions. Fix any existing fixture or test that encoded the opposite assumption. This is a specification and validation change, not a re-architecture.

1. Read `AGENTS.md` in full. Obey every hard rule; they are not negotiable.

3. Write the failing test FIRST. Watch it fail. Do not touch production code
   until you have a red test that fails for the right reason.
4. Make the smallest change that turns it green.
5. Run the four gates yourself before claiming anything:

   ```bash
   cargo fmt --all -- --check
   cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
   cargo test --all-targets
   ./rbops/verify.sh phase-108
   ```

6. Write `REPORT.md` in the exact shape required by `AGENTS.md` section 4.

## Definition of done

- [ ] SPEC.md states that package versions are independent of language versions and gives the reasoning
- [ ] a package manifest can declare a supported language version range, and resolution refuses an out-of-range combination with a catchable error naming both versions
- [ ] a package inside its declared range resolves, asserted on a fixture
- [ ] a boundary case at each end of the declared range is asserted, so the comparison is not off by one
- [ ] every existing manifest test still passes, or is updated with its reason recorded in REPORT.md - no test is deleted to make this fit
- [ ] src/manifest.rs:526's dependency-depth rule still holds and its test is unmodified
- [ ] REPORT.md lists anything that previously conflated the two versions, with what changed for it
